extract.mainText: #14 Alan Rickmanon The Most Trustworthy Celebrities In The World#18 Abraham Lincolnon Famous Men You'd Want To Have A Beer WithCOLLECTION23 LISTSCelebrity OriginsLists of interesting trivia and fun facts about where famous people were born, how they grew up, and what their lives were like when they were young.31 Celebrities Who Are PersianCelebs Who Are BiracialCelebs Who Learned ESLFamous People Born AbroadStars Who Were Born in AfricaOrphaned as ChildrenPeople Who Are Love ChildrenCelebrities Raised in CultsBorn in HawaiiRaised by Single DadsRaised in Actor FamiliesAdopted CelebritiesPeople with Very Long NamesCatholic School AlumniCelebs Who Use Stage NamesPeople Who Lost SiblingsBorn to Teen MothersElementary School ClassmatesCelebrity Children of AddictsFamous JuniorsFinding Your Roots RevelationsRaised by Single MomsCelebs Who Lived in Trailer ParksThis list contains information about Persian celebrities, loosely ranked by fame and popularity. Persian people are Iranians who speak the Persian language. Several famous musicians, athletes, and comedians are Persian. Some of these celebrities were born in the Middle East, whereas others were born in the U.S. to Iranian immigrants. One Saturday Night Live cast member is Persian and speaks fluent Farsi. Who is the most famous person who is Persian? Catherine Bell tops our list. Catherine Bell was born in London to a Persian mother and Scottish father. She moved to the U.S. when she was two years old. Journalist Christiane Amanpour was born in London and raised in Tehran, Iran. Her mother is British and her father is Persian. Andre Agassi was born in Las Vegas and he is of Persian, Armenian, and Assyrian descent. His father, Emmanuel "Mike" Agassi, was an Olympic boxer for Iran.Saturday Night Live alum Nasim Pedrad was born in Tehran, Iran. She moved to the U.S. with her family in 1984, when she was two years old. Actress Shohreh Aghdashloo was born in Tehran, Iran. She made her American film debut in 1989. Featuring Hollywood actors, models, and more, this list of Persian celebs has them all. Are you surprised that so many famous people are Persian? Her mother is British and her father is Persian.Born: 01-12-1958Age: 68Birthplace: London, England, UKDig Deeper Famous Iranian AmericansAnd Deeper People You Forgot Guest Starred on Gilmore GirlsAnd Deeper 19 Celebrities with Rhode Island Tiesload moreNEXT LISTMost Asked QuestionsWho are some of the most famous iranian people in Hollywood?+A: Catherine Bell and Shohreh Aghdashloo are two of the most recognizable names. Catherine Bell, known for JAG, was born to a Persian mother, while Shohreh Aghdashloo made history as the first Iranian woman nominated for an Academy Award for her role in House of Sand and Fog. You've also likely seen Nasim Pedrad on Saturday Night Live or New Girl.Which famous Persian women are successful iranian american actresses?+A: Sarah Shahi and Nazanin Boniadi have both built incredible careers in American television. Sarah Shahi starred in Person of Interest and The L Word, bringing her Persian and Spanish heritage to the screen. Nazanin Boniadi is another major talent, moving from General Hospital to major roles in Homeland and The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power.Are there any famous people from Iran who are athletes or journalists?+A: Andre Agassi is one of the most legendary athletes with Persian roots, as his father was an Olympic boxer for Iran before moving to Las Vegas. In the world of journalism, Christiane Amanpour is a household name who was raised in Tehran. Her deep connection to her Persian heritage has informed her world-class reporting for decades.How have famous Persian people influenced American comedy?+A: Maz Jobrani and Nasim Pedrad are leading the way for Persian representation in comedy. Maz Jobrani is a founding member of the Axis of Evil Comedy Tour and has several hilarious specials that lean into his Iranian-American experience. Nasim Pedrad spent five seasons on Saturday Night Live, where she even used her fluent Farsi in sketches, proving her range to millions of viewers.What famous Persian actors in america have appeared in popular TV shows?+A: Omid Abtahi and Artemis Pebdani are faces you definitely recognize from some of the biggest shows on TV. Omid Abtahi has appeared in everything from The Mandalorian to American Gods, while Artemis Pebdani is a fan favorite as Artemis on It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia. Both actors consistently deliver great performances that keep fans watching.
